fieldValues.title: A Tier-0 note in the tree took down the whole traversal, and the fix was at the root
fieldValues.summary: tree_service read every node through the Tier-2-only get_record_by_id. RFC-013 scaffolds repository sections as Tier-0 notes, so a note anywhere in the tree raised a hard missing-typeId error that aborted the entire traversal - of a repository that repo validate calls healthy. The new child_ids resolves and orders targets by id, so a note walks like any other node.
evidence: get_record_by_id is Tier-2 only; tree_service called it for every node
RFC-013 scaffolds section roots as Tier-0 notes
The failure was total, not partial: one note aborted the traversal for the whole repository
The same bug broke srs tree on the same corpora, not only navigation
fieldValues.body: Fixing it in the navigation caller would have left srs tree broken on the same data. One tier-aware resolution in the shared walker is both the smaller diff and the root cause - the same shape as the nav-root-is-member class of bug, where a loader assumption about tier silently empties a whole view.
